name: secret-broker
description: mTLS Secret Broker with SOPS-backed credentials, proxy-mode for AI clients

scripts.lint: cd .. && npx --no-install eslint --config eslint.config.js broker/ broker-test/ cli/ 2>&1 | tail -40
scripts.lint:fix: cd .. && npx --no-install eslint --config eslint.config.js --fix broker/ broker-test/ cli/ 2>&1 | tail -40
scripts.test:routes: node ../broker-test/test-routes-phase-b2.js && node ../broker-test/test-routes-auth-me.js && node ../broker-test/test-routes-b4.js && node ../broker-test/test-dashboard-admin-visibility.js && node ../broker-test/test-local-health.js && node ../broker-test/test-aliyun-rpc.js && node ../broker-test/test-doh.js && node ../broker-test/test-outbound-relay.js
scripts.test:v4: npm run test:redact && npm run test:mfa && npm run test:sms && npm run test:apikeys-v4 && npm run test:cert-issuer && npm run test:security-headers && npm run test:static && npm run test:mtls && npm run test:can-proxy-policy && npm run test:read-api && npm run test:audit-async && npm run test:audit-hash-chain && npm run test:fuzz-parsers && npm run test:log && npm run test:webauthn
scripts.test:p2: npm run test:workload && npm run test:ssh && npm run test:ws
scripts.test:verify: npm run test:modular && npm run test:v4-modules && npm run test:workload && npm run test:ssh && npm run test:ws
scripts.test:python-sdk: cd ../sdk/python && python -m pip install --quiet pytest pytest-asyncio cryptography && python -m pytest tests/ -q && cd ../../broker
scripts.test:verify-all: npm run test:verify && npm run test:python-sdk
scripts.test:modular: npm run test:lib && npm run test:ip && npm run test:routes && npm run test:obs && npm run test:trace && npm run test:ops && npm run test:backup && npm run test:v4
